🚀 From zero to church in one command

Getting started

Pick how you want to run churchit. Most churches self-host with Docker: one command on any spare Linux box, VPS, or mini-PC.

Recommended 🐳 Self-host with Docker

One command. That's the whole install.

Run this in a terminal on the machine that will host churchit (Linux, Windows via WSL, or macOS with Docker Desktop). It installs Docker if it's missing, asks for your domain, generates strong passwords, and starts everything.

{one_liner}
⚠️ Alpha software. churchit is still in active development and is not yet ready for official/production use. Please install it for testing and evaluation only.

Windows and macOS steps, a real domain with HTTPS, DNS and port forwarding, password resets, and uninstalling are all in the self-hosting guide →
